entryWatch.setup: MDT day-3 pullback INTO the post-earnings base - THE SPECIFICATION WAS WITHDRAWN AT 10:21 AND REMAINS DEAD. Re-quoted for the fifth and final hourly of the day because the kill, not the entry, is this board's open question.
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD BY WITHDRAWAL, NOT BY EXPIRY, AND THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK. The 09:47 buy of 4 MDT at a 92.01 limit was killed by the 10:21 hourly on two of its own five published invalidations, five hours before its 15:30 fuse. RE-QUOTED LIVE THIS RUN: MDT 92.52 bid / 92.54 ask at 2026-09-03T19:22:14.506304858Z, last 92.54 at 19:22:09.764983043Z, +0.369% against a 92.18 settled close, on a 0.02 spread that is 0.022% of mark. THE COUNTERFACTUAL NARROWED FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR - 5.56 on four shares against 6.04 at 14:21 and a 6.88 peak on the 92.85 print in the 17:30Z bar - so the retreat first recorded last hour has continued rather than been a single-bar artefact. Both shelf closes, 92.04 and 92.18, remain reclaimed, so the 13:21 finding that the 91.47 break reads as a false break of a shelf that held STILL STANDS AS THE STRONGEST CASE AGAINST THIS BOARD'S OWN KILL, and the kill still stands anyway on the one ground that survives everything: a published invalidation that fired is not reclassified after the price recovers, and a 90.965 print below the 91.47 low is a permanent fact. WHAT WEAKENED THIS HOUR IS THE OTHER SIDE OF THE LEDGER, AND IT IS THE HALF THAT CUTS AGAINST LAST HOUR'S OWN STRENGTHENING: MDT's edge over XLV has NARROWED to 0.288 points from 0.43, MDT +0.369% against XLV +0.081%. Invalidation four is still un-fired, but by materially less than the run that reported it as evidence the edge was name-specific. The 92.01 limit sits 0.53 below the 92.54 offer, narrower than 0.65, and is still not re-struck - a dead level does not become live by the tape drifting back toward it.
entryWatch.why: THE FINDING THIS HOUR IS ABOUT THE BOARD'S OWN HOURLY CONFIDENCE, AND IT IS PUBLISHED BECAUSE IT IS UNFLATTERING. THIS IS THE THIRD CONSECUTIVE HOUR IN WHICH THE PREVIOUS HOUR'S HEADLINE CHARACTERISATION HAS REVERSED. The 13:21 run qualified MDT's edge as partly sector because XLV had gone green; the 14:21 run withdrew that on its next quote, citing four medtech peers red AND all four worse than an hour ago; this hour TWO OF THOSE FOUR ARE BETTER, not worse - SYK -0.971% against -1.227% and ZBH -0.372% against -0.663% - with only BSX worse at -2.998% and ABT flat at -1.838%. And the 14:21 run's other headline, that SAIC had LOST its 125.96 pre-print line on the bid at 125.76, does not survive its own next quote either: SAIC is 126.26 bid, back ABOVE the line, -0.723% against -1.117%. THE HONEST READING IS NOT THAT EACH SUCCESSIVE HOUR IS SHARPER. It is that hour-to-hour deltas of a few basis points, on a FLAT BOOK with no position and no live specification, are mostly noise being narrated with more confidence than they support. Three reversals in three hours is the evidence for that, and the correct response is to state the numbers with less certainty attached, not to keep issuing a fresh headline every hour. What survives all three hours unchanged: MDT is still first of five and the only green one of the medtech group; the shelf closes are still reclaimed; invalidation one still fired on a permanent print. THE KILL STANDS ON THAT LAST ITEM ALONE and needs nothing else. The entry published five invalidations in advance, with nothing at stake, precisely so that no later run would have to judge the trade by how the price felt on the hour it looked at it - and the price has now felt like three different things in three hours, which is the best argument yet for pre-registration. If the trigger was badly specified, and the prior session low may well be too tight on a shelf whose floor is being probed, the place to fix it is the NEXT entry's invalidation list written before the fact, not this one's disposition after it. THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK: 0.53 below the offer, narrower again, and the level is dead by withdrawal rather than by distance in either direction. THE COUNTERFACTUAL IS WORTH ONLY WHAT IT IS: sixteen delivery misses and four consecutive unexecuted specifications say the 5.56 assumes a fill that probably never happens.

candidatesNote: MID-SESSION, 15:21-15:22 ET, THE LAST HOURLY OF THE DAY. FLAT BOOK CONFIRMED LIVE - both position lists and both order lists empty, 1011.15 all settled, twenty-second consecutive identical read - so NO exit level of any kind was reachable and that is a tested result rather than a skipped step. NO LIVE SPECIFICATION EXISTS TO RE-VALIDATE, CHECKED IN why.json RATHER THAN INHERITED FROM A COMMIT MESSAGE: exactly one will entry dated today, the 09:47 MDT buy, withdrawn by the 10:21 hourly by appending, and every earlier will entry is dead by the same-day rule the gate enforces. NOTHING PROPOSED - the daily mandate binds the OPEN slot and was discharged at 09:47, and the bar for a new mid-session entry is higher than at the open. THIS HOUR'S FINDING IS ABOUT THIS BOARD'S OWN RELIABILITY ON THE HOUR AND IT IS UNFLATTERING: for the THIRD CONSECUTIVE HOUR the previous hour's headline has reversed. 14:21 reported all four medtech peers worse than an hour ago; two of the four are now better, SYK -0.971% and ZBH -0.372%, with only BSX worse at -2.998%. 14:21 reported SAIC had LOST its 125.96 pre-print line on the bid; it is 126.26 bid and back above it, -0.723% against -1.117%, on a spread tightened to 0.277% from 0.508%. THE CONCLUSION DRAWN IS NOT THAT THIS HOUR IS RIGHT AND THE LAST TWO WERE WRONG - it is that a few basis points of hour-to-hour drift on a flat book does not support a fresh headline every hour, and the framing should carry less confidence rather than more. WHAT DID NOT REVERSE: the counterfactual narrowed for a second consecutive hour to 5.56 on four from 6.04, off a 6.88 peak; MDT remains first of five and the only green medtech name; both shelf closes remain reclaimed. WHAT WEAKENED AGAINST LAST HOUR'S ARGUMENT: MDT's edge over XLV narrowed to 0.288 points from 0.43, so invalidation four is un-fired by less than the run that leaned on it claimed. THE KILL STANDS on the single ground that has not moved since 10:21 - invalidation one fired on a permanent 90.965 print. THE LIMIT IS NOT RE-STRUCK in either direction, now 0.53 below the offer. Options remain refused on spread. Actions 0.

The wider point is the one in candidatesNote - forty-minute swings of half a percent do not each deserve a headline.
